subphaseWeights.note: ASSUMPTION: four quadrants = four equal 25% chunks of the 5,250 bar ('Once enough damage is reached, Ocellus will announce Obliteration... and begin charging a blast that will destroy the quadrant'; 'When only one quadrant remains, Ocellus will say End...'). The wiki gives no per-quadrant threshold. Shares below = (events per rotation / events in the rotation) x weight.

conventions: share = fraction of 6-tick attack cycles in which the row OCCURS, already multiplied by the subphase weight (avoidable rows included, as in the other files of this folder; they are never counted). Rows that are an alternative to another row (the spread void shot replaces the melee auto), solo-irrelevant, or one-off per quadrant carry share 0 and say so; 'shareIfCounted' then holds the occurrence share. Rows with their own speedTicks: share = fraction of phase time during which that cadence runs. All shares sum to <= 1 (0.98); counted rows sum to 0.63.

attacks.name: Melee auto-attack (slash at the tank)
attacks.note: Ocellus page: 'He will use an auto-attack, slashing at the player twice before sending a line of AOE smoke magic at the player. Pray melee during the first two hits'. Strategies: 'Ocellus' attack pattern is 2 standard melee attacks followed by a directional wave attack that will travel across the arena. After 2 wave attacks, he will begin a charged blade attack'. Rotation = melee, melee, wave, melee, melee, wave, smite = 7 events; melee 4/7 = 0.571 x 0.75 weight = 0.43, trimmed to 0.40 to leave room for the occasional specials. MAX HIT not on the wiki. Full block under Protect from Melee is assumed (the wiki says 'pray melee', nothing about a leak). Solo: the player is always the tank.

attacks.name: Smoke wave (directional magic AoE line)
attacks.note: Ocellus page: 'sending a line of AOE smoke magic at the player. ... run out of the way of the smoke magic to avoid damage.' Strategies: 'a directional wave attack that will travel across the arena'. 2/7 of the rotation x 0.75 = 0.21. No damage number. Dodged by stepping out of the line -> avoidable.

attacks.name: Charged blade / melee smite (prayer-flick, 1-3 spins)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'he will begin a charged blade attack, noted by a spinning purple portal opening underneath him. To protect against this attack, have protect from melee active before the attack is initiated, then disable your overhead prayer and activate protect from melee prior to the attack being released.' Ocellus page: 'When Ocellus spins, turn off protection prayers, then as soon as you see his saw blades, turn protect from melee back on. With each quadrant destroyed, Ocellus will add another spin onto this attack ... requiring the player to turn the melee prayer off-and-on up to 3 times by the 3rd quadrant. Ocellus will also drop debris on to the player during this attack, so stepping after each successful attack is advised'. hits = spins: 1 in quadrant 1, 2 in quadrant 2, 3 in quadrant 3 -> average 2. 1/7 of the rotation x 0.75 = 0.107. MAX HIT not on the wiki. leak 0.1 = my guess at a missed off/on flick; the debris is dodged by stepping.

attacks.name: Spread void shot (tank not within 2 tiles)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'If he is unable to reach the targeted player, he will attack with a powerful spread void shot dealing 20+ damage to each player.' Ocellus page: 'If the tank is not within 2 tiles of the boss, he will send out a mage attack at all players in the quadrant'. '20+' = at least 20, exact max unknown. Avoidable for a melee tank who stays within 2 tiles. LOADOUT-DEPENDENT: a solo ranged/magic player standing off replaces the melee auto with THIS as the auto (hence shareIfCounted 0.40 = the melee auto's share); prayer: 'pray mage' is only stated for Untether, so full block under Protect from Magic is an assumption.

attacks.name: Void Vine root ('The void... will take you...')
attacks.note: Strategies: 'Ocellus will occasionally shout The void... will take you... and root 1 player in place with a Void Vine that can only be attacked by another player. Failure to break the vine in time will deal upwards of 50 damage.' Void Vine page: 44 hitpoints, 'A teammate must attack the vine and break it, or else it will deal upwards of 50 damage.' In a team it is avoidable (break the vine). SOLO: no teammate can break it, and the wiki does not say whether it is used solo - modelled as a rare landing hit (share 0.01 = 'occasionally', my guess) and flagged.

attacks.name: Void Rift / Void Augmenter / Void Siphon left alive
attacks.note: Strategies: 'Ocellus will spawn Void Rifts, Void Augmenters or Void Siphons in each quadrant which, when defeated, will empower the player who kills it. Failure to kill them will damage all players.' Rift/Augmenter pages: 44 hitpoints, def 175, mage 300, 75% Earth weakness; 'most melee attacks can kill in two or three hits'. No damage number. Avoidable by killing them.

attacks.name: Insolence (3 wide waves + lasting damaging field)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'If Ocellus announces Insolence..., he will target 3 random players in series to send wide wave attacks similar to earlier wave attacks. However these are much larger and leave a lasting damaging field where they impact.' Ocellus page: 'Run out of the way of the tremors while avoiding the debris left behind.' No number. Avoidable.

attacks.name: Untether: magic autos while airborne
attacks.note: Strategies: 'After a certain number of special attacks, Ocellus will Untether... and begin floating in the air and be unable to be reached by melee attacks. Damaging purple portals will begin spawning on the ground, and the boss will continue attacking with magic.' Ocellus page: 'When Ocellus says Untether..., pray mage, and avoid purple dots.' The camped prayer flips to magic for the window -> blocked (assumed full). No max hit, no count of autos; share 0.02 is a guess for the fraction of cycles spent airborne.

attacks.name: Untether: ground eruption + landing slam
attacks.note: Strategies: 'The entire ground will eventually erupt in a void attack, dealing 40+ damage. To avoid this, stand underneath the boss (inside the purple lines). The border will glow brighter twice before the attack commences and Ocellus will slam inside this safe area, dealing a similar amount of damage. Time your escape on the final glow of the purple border to avoid both attacks simultaneously.' Both dodged by the step-under / step-out -> avoidable; '40+' = at least 40.

attacks.name: Void pools under non-tank players (quadrant start)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'At the start of this phase, as well as the following two quadrants, void pools will spawn underneath all players except for the tank, dealing periodic damage when stepped in.' Solo the player is the tank, so none spawn for them. Teams: avoid by not stepping in.

attacks.name: Obliteration / 'Run... It matters not...' (quadrant destroyed)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'Once enough damage is reached, Ocellus will announce Obliteration... or Run... It matters not... and begin charging a blast that will destroy the quadrant. The player is killed if they do not jump via the gaps to another quadrant in time.' Lethal if ignored, avoided by jumping; three times per phase.

attacks.name: Health steal (blue wind attack: half current HP, returned by the orb)
attacks.note: Strategies (Phase 4 step 2): 'Ocellus will perform an attack to all players (appears as a blue, wind-like attack above the player), dealing half of each player's current health as damage, rounded down. These hitpoints are transferred to light blue orb will spawn on a safe tile in the quadrant and is invisible to other players. After a few seconds, the orb will begin to animate and you can walk into it to regain the lost HP.' Repeated at step 7. Unavoidable and prayer-blind, but recouped when the orb is collected -> net ~0 if the plugin counts healing; count it as burst risk otherwise. Share: 2 per enrage cycle; cycle estimated at ~60 ticks = 10 six-tick cadences -> 2/10 = 0.2 x 0.25 weight = 0.05 (cycle length is my estimate: two 12-tick explosion sequences plus rise/land/charge animations).

attacks.name: Void explosions under the player (6 per sequence, two sequences per cycle)
attacks.note: Strategies (step 3): 'Every two ticks, a void explosion will begin at each player's current tile and deal damage on the next tick, requiring players to constantly move to avoid damage. While the explosions are occurring the boss takes 60% less damage ... If the player dodges the void explosion tick perfectly within a 1 tile radius, then their next attack will have attack cooldown reduces by 3 ticks ... This repeats six times.' Ocellus page: 'void explosions under the player every 2 ticks ... 6 void explosions will occur in total'. No damage number. Avoided by moving every 2 ticks (tick-perfect only for the cooldown bonus). shareIfCounted 0.10 = the fraction of phase time this 2-tick cadence runs (24 of ~60 ticks per cycle x 0.25 weight).

attacks.name: Void blast, whole quadrant (melee / ranged / magic, pattern-telegraphed)
attacks.styleNote: any one of melee, ranged, magic each time; the floor pattern tells which (red blades = melee, green arrows = ranged, blue pulsing circle = magic)
attacks.note: Strategies (step 5): 'Ocellus will switch to using the Soul Split prayer. He will then perform a void blast that hits the entire quadrant. If the attack is not prayed against, it will deal 40+ damage; if prayed, it will deal ~6-7 damage. The attack can be any style, indicated by the pattern underneath the boss.' Repeated at step 8. prayerFactor = 6.5 / 40 = 0.16 (uses 40 as the max; the wiki says '40+'). flicked: the style must be read off the pattern each time; leak 0.1 = my guess at misreads. Share: 2 per ~60-tick cycle = 2/10 cadences x 0.25 = 0.05. This is the main QUANTIFIED unavoidable damage of the fight: ~6-7 twice per cycle.

attacks.name: Void Rifts charging (enrage step 1)
attacks.note: Strategies (step 1): 'Except for the start of this phase, Ocellus will additionally spawn Void Rifts that must be destroyed before they charge up to prevent taking damage.' No number; avoidable by killing them (44 HP).

phases: Quadrants 1-3 ('Phase 3'): tank in orb order (2nd, then 3rd, ...; 'Ocellus will swap tank when either the tank dies or next corner quadrant begins'); rotation melee, melee, wave, melee, melee, wave, charged blade; specials 'after a certain number of special attacks': Untether (airborne, magic autos, eruption 40+, slam), Insolence (3 waves), Void Vine (50+ if unbroken), Void Rifts/Augmenters/Siphons; Obliteration destroys the quadrant. Final quadrant ('Phase 4', 'End...'): fixed 8-step cycle - rise + Deflect Melee (+Void Rifts after the first time) -> half-HP steal -> 6 explosions every 2 ticks -> land -> Soul Split + void blast (40+ / ~6-7 prayed) -> void floor + Deflect Range -> steal + explosions -> blast; repeats until dead. Ocellus page adds: in the floating phase 'void crystals that the player will always max hit with standard range attacks'; in the other 'a 1-tile zone around him that players must stay within to not be damaged'.
sanityOrOther: Ruinous Powers in the enrage: Deflect Melee while floating (steps 1-4), Deflect Range in steps 6-8, Soul Split during the blast - attacking with the deflected style reflects damage (amount not on the wiki). Censers (phase 3): Bandosian = next melee attack max hits ('Zaryte crossbow special attack with ruby bolts after the censer has been used increases its max hit to 121'), Armadylean = next ranged max hit, Zarosian = 50% spec restore, Saradomin = 50 healing and 50 prayer. Void Augmenter kill: 'attack and strength to 116, and magic and ranged to 112'; Void Rift kill resets the attack cooldown; Void Siphon heals. Protect from Melee overhead icon shows in phase 3 (hotfix 21 Oct 2026). Expected quantified unavoidable DTPS under standard play: enrage blasts 2 x ~6.5 per ~60 ticks (~0.36 HP/s) + Void Vine risk + half-HP steals (recoverable); everything else is prayed or dodged, and the melee/smite max hits are unknown.
uncertainReason: No max hit for the melee auto, smoke wave or smite (infobox blank); quadrant HP split and enrage cycle length are estimates; Void Vine behaviour solo unknown; prayer on the spread void shot assumed.
